excluded_models.reason: Arctic-Embed 2.0 large is initialized from bge-m3-retromae (BAAI, Beijing). AGENTS.md excludes BGE and its fine-tunes. Source: Arctic-Embed 2.0 paper, arXiv:2412.04506, section 2.1.
Arctic-Embed 2.0 medium is initialized from Alibaba gte-multilingual-mlm-base. AGENTS.md excludes GTE and its fine-tunes. Same paper, section 2.1.

embeddinggemma-2.lineage: Gemma 4 text backbone from Google DeepMind (released Oct 2026). Not a fine-tune of a PRC model. Text-only load is about 270M of the 740M multimodal checkpoint.

granite-english-r2.lineage: ModernBERT architecture (Answer.AI, US, and LightOn, France), trained by IBM. No PRC base model. English R2 (Aug 2025, 149M) is still the newest English Granite embedder; the May 2026 multilingual R2 models are a different, multilingual line.

arctic-embed-l.lineage: Arctic-Embed 1.0 large, initialized from Microsoft intfloat/e5-large-unsupervised (BERT-large). The newer arctic-embed-l-v2.0 and arctic-embed-m-v2.0 are excluded: v2 large starts from BAAI bge-m3-retromae and v2 medium from Alibaba gte-multilingual-mlm-base (arXiv:2412.04506, sec. 2.1).

nomic-embed-text-v2-moe.lineage: Latest Nomic text embedder (Feb 2025). Model tree: FacebookAI/xlm-roberta-base (Meta) -> nomic-ai/nomic-xlm-2048 -> nomic-embed-text-v2-moe-unsupervised -> this checkpoint. nomic-ai/modernbert-embed-base is older (Dec 2024) and was not substituted. XLM-RoBERTa is not a PRC model.
